## Summary

Describe the dashboard, workbook, calculation, export, documentation, or security change.

## Change Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Workbook parsing or schema
- [ ] KPI or compliance calculation
- [ ] PDF / Excel / print export
- [ ] Security or privacy
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Tested with synthetic or formally approved data
- [ ] No personal, confidential, credential, or production workbook data is committed
- [ ] Workbook sheet and column assumptions are documented
- [ ] Dashboard totals were reconciled to source rows
- [ ] Thai and English user-facing content remains consistent
- [ ] Workbook-derived values are validated and safely rendered
- [ ] Filters, refresh behavior, and affected routes were tested
- [ ] PDF, Excel, or print output was reviewed when affected
- [ ] Error messages do not expose sensitive data or internal paths
- [ ] Legal or audit logic changes received appropriate domain review
- [ ] README or technical documentation was updated where required
- [ ] The change is compatible with the repository license

## Evidence and Impact

Provide test notes, screenshots using non-sensitive data, calculation reconciliation, affected routes, and any migration or deployment considerations.
